selected_sample: Existing environment_validation selected_titan==true,401 unique ZTF–TITAN events
positional_coordinate: ZTF ra_host/dec_host matched to individual Tully table5 galaxy GLON/GLAT converted to ICRS
group_definition: Only published Nest membership of matched individual galaxy; require Nmb>=2
depth_model: Diagnostic uniform independent line-of-sight member offset within +/-1.5R2t; variance=(5/ln10*1.5R2t/D)^2/3 in small-depth approximation; also exact endpoint magnitude span. Not an empirically calibrated group-depth posterior.
velocity_model: Group coherent velocity nuisance cancels with group intercept; member line-of-sight depth does not. Catalogue sigP sets the redshift-based distance-error comparison, not an additional group-distance term to add twice.
age_inference: Conditional shared SN identifier and bothDLR<4 do not verify TITAN host coordinates absent from old snapshot; age comparison cannot be labelled unambiguous physical host-age inference.
comparison_if_supported: At least5 independent repeated groups and residual age-design rank after group intercept/width/colour/mass to fit conditional brightness-age relation; fewer groups => only inventory/contrast and precision diagnosis, no unreliable population-significance claim.
status: Choices frozen before new host-to-Tully crossmatch outcomes.
